title: Style of photographs – how is it being depicted?

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines
location.section: Style of photographs – how is it being depicted?

slide_intent: Choose photographic treatment that feels believable and specific because atmosphere shapes whether a city story feels authentic or generic.
strategic_value: Natural movement, unusual viewpoints and real weather can make Helsinki’s character more memorable.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section compares natural movement, unposed activity, peculiar details, unusual viewpoints, rain and storm light, then states retouching and black-and-white guidance.
practical_value: Assess viewpoint, light and editing alongside subject matter; preserve natural results.

content_islands.name: Human atmosphere
content_islands.spec: Compare natural motion and unposed people.

content_islands.name: Authentic character
content_islands.spec: Show distinctive details and real events against generic staged alternatives.

content_islands.name: Light and viewpoint
content_islands.spec: Compare angles, night reflections and dramatic weather.

content_islands.name: Finishing guidance
content_islands.spec: End with natural retouching and historical black-and-white scope.

ingredient.name: Photographic treatment
ingredient.role: Give city stories a natural yet distinctive atmosphere.
ingredient.application: Use believable motion, authentic activity and considered light, viewpoint and crop; keep retouching natural.
ingredient.scope: Reserve black and white for historical subjects; the examples do not prescribe a universal camera setting or filter.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says atmosphere and unusual viewpoints can evoke stronger emotions and make messages memorable.
reference_purposes.Application: The paired photographs compare treatments of similar subjects.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Black-and-white images are used only for historical subjects; retouching must remain natural.
